Problem Identification: Predict annual insurance charges from demographics and lifestyle to support fast, fair premium quoting.
Data Issues / EDA: Data from regression.db → Insurance_Prediction. Target: charges. Train/val split 80/20. Numeric/categorical separation. Median imputation (numeric), most-frequent (categorical). StandardScaler for numeric. OneHotEncoder(drop='first') for categoricals. Checked outliers, correlation: smoker, coverage, BMI, age strongest.
ML Model features: Input features: age,bmi,children,smoker,region,medical_history,family_medical_history,exercise_frequency,occupation,coverage_level. Pipeline: SimpleImputer+StandardScaler (numeric), SimpleImputer+OneHotEncoder(drop='first') (categorical). Models compared: rf, et, gbr, ridge, lasso, en, sgd. Selection by test R² from leaderboard.
Results: Best model: ridge; R²_test=0.8246; MAE=1463.6; RMSE=1845.5. Top drivers: coverage_level_Premium, smoker_yes, medical_history_Heart disease, exercise_frequency_Never, region_southwest.
Business Impact: Faster, consistent premium quoting; transparent reasoning via feature importance; compliance/reporting through downloadable prediction report; better stakeholder trust and UX via dashboard.
